The collector label is 1•7. This numbered #1a presentation is distinct from the [[Darth Vader (V) (Virtual Set 1)|earlier unnumbered #1a slip]], the [[Darth Vader (V) (Virtual Set 1: Legacy) (Premium Edition)|Premium Edition]] and the [[Darth Vader (V) (Virtual Set 1) (Errata 2)|later PC remastered slip]]. The sheet states tournament legality from 9 March 2002.
